```{r}
library(tidyverse, ggplot2)
library(nflfastR)
library(fuzzyjoin)
library(gt)

all_plays <- read.csv("~/Documents/Football_R/CMSAC--Field Value/PBP_Efficiency/top20_pbp_efficiency.csv")
```

NFL Receiving Stats
```{r}
# 1. Calculate aggregated player stats for the 2023 regular season
stats_2023 <- calculate_stats(
  seasons = 2023, 
  summary_level = "season", 
  season_type = "REG"
)

# 2. Select the specific receiving columns and sort by receiving yards
receiving_leaderboard <- stats_2023 %>%
  select(
    player_name,
    recent_team,
    receptions,
    targets,
    receiving_yards,
    receiving_yards_after_catch
  ) %>%
  mutate(air_yds = receiving_yards - receiving_yards_after_catch,
         air_ypr = air_yds/receptions,
         comp_pct = receptions/targets) %>% 
  arrange(desc(receiving_yards)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
  arrange(desc(air_ypr))

# View the top receivers (matching Tyreek Hill, CeeDee Lamb, etc.)
head(receiving_leaderboard)
```

```{r}
# aDOT: average route depth on plays where the player was the targeted receiver
adot_df <- all_plays %>%
  filter(player_role == "Targeted Receiver") %>%
  group_by(nfl_id) %>%
  summarize(aDOT = mean(route_depth, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

t20_season_RTE_2023 <- all_plays %>% 
  group_by(player_name, nfl_id, route_group) %>% 
  summarize(
    mRTE = median(peak_frame_efficiency),
    aRTE = median(avg_play_efficiency),
    avg_final_eff = median(final_frame_efficiency),
    routes_run = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  # one row per player, one column per route_group x metric
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(player_name, nfl_id),
    names_from = route_group,
    values_from = c(mRTE, aRTE, avg_final_eff, routes_run),
    names_glue = "{route_group}_{.value}"
  ) %>% 
  # total routes across all groups, for target_rate later
  mutate(
    total_routes = rowSums(across(ends_with("_routes_run")), na.rm = FALSE)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(adot_df, by = "nfl_id") %>%
  mutate(player_abbr = case_when(
      player_name == "Amari Cooper" ~ "A.Cooper",
      player_name == "Brandon Aiyuk" ~ "B.Aiyuk",
      player_name == "Justin Jefferson" ~ "J.Jefferson",
      player_name == "George Pickens" ~ "G.Pickens",
      player_name == "Mike Evans" ~ "M.Evans",
      player_name == "DK Metcalf" ~ "D.Metcalf",
      player_name == "Tyreek Hill" ~ "T.Hill",
      player_name == "DeVonta Smith" ~ "D.Smith",
      player_name == "Nico Collins" ~ "N.Collins",
      player_name == "A.J. Brown" ~ "A.Brown",
      player_name == "Chris Olave" ~ "C.Olave",
      player_name == "DJ Moore" ~ "D.Moore",
      player_name == "Puka Nacua" ~ "P.Nacua",
      player_name == "CeeDee Lamb" ~ "C.Lamb",
      player_name == "Davante Adams" ~ "D.Adams",
      player_name == "Keenan Allen" ~ "K.Allen",
      player_name == "Stefon Diggs" ~ "S.Diggs",
      player_name == "Amon-Ra St. Brown" ~ "A.St. Brown",
      player_name == "Ja'Marr Chase" ~ "J.Chase",
      player_name == "Michael Pittman" ~ "M.Pittman",
      TRUE ~ player_name
    )
  ) %>% 
  left_join(receiving_leaderboard, by = c("player_abbr" = "player_name")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(air_ypr)) %>% 
  mutate(target_rate = targets / total_routes)
```

VIZUAL: mRTE and aRTE are effective in measuring a combination of downfield threat and space creation. 

```{r}
library(gt)
library(dplyr)

route_groups <- c("Short", "Medium", "Long", "Ultra-Long")

# 1. Percentile functions built from play-level max-frame efficiency,
#    one per route group (so a Short route is compared against other Short routes)
mRTE_ecdfs <- all_plays %>%
  split(.$route_group) %>%
  map(~ ecdf(.x$peak_frame_efficiency))

# 2. Convert each receiver's per-group mean to a percentile (0-100)
gt_prep <- t20_season_RTE_2023
for (g in route_groups) {
  col <- paste0(g, "_mRTE")
  gt_prep[[col]] <- mRTE_ecdfs[[g]](gt_prep[[col]]) * 100
}

gt_prep <- gt_prep %>%
  select(
    player_name, recent_team,
    Short = Short_mRTE,
    Medium = Medium_mRTE,
    Long = Long_mRTE,
    `Ultra-Long` = `Ultra-Long_mRTE`,
    air_yds, total_routes, targets, target_rate, comp_pct, aDOT
  )

# 3. Construct 2023 GT table
gt_table <- gt_prep %>%
  arrange(desc(air_yds)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**2023 Wide Receiver mRTE by Route Depth & Opportunity Metrics**"),
    subtitle = md("mRTE: On his average route of this depth, this WR is more dangerous than X% of all Top-20 WR routes of the same depth")
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "mRTE Percentile by Route Group",
    columns = all_of(route_groups)
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    player_name = "Player",
    recent_team = "Team",
    air_yds = "Air Rec Yards",
    total_routes = "Routes Run",
    targets = "Targets",
    target_rate = "Target Rate",
    comp_pct = "Comp %",
    aDOT = "aDOT"
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = c(comp_pct, target_rate), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(all_of(route_groups), aDOT), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(targets, air_yds, total_routes), decimals = 0) %>%
  sub_missing(columns = all_of(route_groups), missing_text = "—") %>%
  data_color(
    columns = all_of(route_groups),
    palette = c("#D73027", "#FFFFBF", "#1A9850"),
    domain = c(0, 100),
    na_color = "#EEEEEE"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(player_name, recent_team)) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(all_of(route_groups), targets, air_yds, comp_pct, target_rate, total_routes, aDOT)
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(13),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )

gtsave(gt_table, filename = "receiver_RTE_table_2023.png")
gt_table
```

Compare against targets-only RTE
```{r}
route_groups <- c("Short", "Medium", "Long", "Ultra-Long")
tgt_cols     <- paste0(route_groups, "_tgt")

# 1. Percentile functions (unchanged)
mRTE_ecdfs <- all_plays %>%
  # filter(player_role == "Targeted Receiver") %>% 
  split(.$route_group) %>%
  map(~ ecdf(.x$peak_frame_efficiency))

# 2. Convert each receiver's per-group median to a percentile (0-100)
gt_prep <- t20_targets_RTE_2023
for (g in route_groups) {
  col <- paste0(g, "_mRTE")
  gt_prep[[col]] <- mRTE_ecdfs[[g]](gt_prep[[col]]) * 100
}

gt_prep <- gt_prep %>%
  arrange(desc(air_yds)) %>%
  select(
    player_name, recent_team,
    Short = Short_mRTE,
    Medium = Medium_mRTE,
    Long = Long_mRTE,
    `Ultra-Long` = `Ultra-Long_mRTE`,
    Short_tgt = Short_routes_run,
    Medium_tgt = Medium_routes_run,
    Long_tgt = Long_routes_run,
    `Ultra-Long_tgt` = `Ultra-Long_routes_run`
  ) %>%
  # no targets in a group = 0, not missing
  mutate(across(all_of(tgt_cols), ~ coalesce(.x, 0))) %>%
  # convert counts to share of the receiver's total targets
  mutate(
    total_tgt = rowSums(across(all_of(tgt_cols))),
    across(all_of(tgt_cols), ~ if_else(total_tgt > 0, .x / total_tgt, 0))
  ) %>%
  select(-total_tgt)

# 3. Construct 2023 GT table
gt_table <- gt_prep %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**2023 Wide Receiver mRTE by Target Depth & Target Distribution**"),
    subtitle = md("Targets Only | mRTE: On his average target of this depth, this WR is more dangerous than X% of all Top-20 WR routes of the same depth")
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "mRTE Percentile by Target Depth",
    columns = all_of(route_groups)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "% of Targets by Depth",
    columns = all_of(tgt_cols)
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    player_name = "Player",
    recent_team = "Team",
    Short_tgt = "Short",
    Medium_tgt = "Medium",
    Long_tgt = "Long",
    `Ultra-Long_tgt` = "Ultra-Long"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = all_of(route_groups), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = all_of(tgt_cols), decimals = 1) %>%
  sub_missing(columns = all_of(route_groups), missing_text = "—") %>%
  data_color(
    columns = all_of(route_groups),
    palette = c("#D73027", "#FFFFBF", "#1A9850"),
    domain = c(0, 100),
    na_color = "#EEEEEE"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(player_name, recent_team)) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(all_of(route_groups), all_of(tgt_cols))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "left", color = "#999999", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Short_tgt)
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(13),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )

gtsave(gt_table, filename = "receiver__targets_RTE_table_2023.png")
gt_table
```





Use 2023 RTE to predict 2024 Stats
```{r}
# 1. Calculate aggregated player stats for the 2024 regular season
stats_2024 <- calculate_stats(
  seasons = 2024, 
  summary_level = "season", 
  season_type = "REG"
)

# 2. Select receiving columns and apply the 100-target minimum filter
receiving_leaderboard_2024 <- stats_2024 %>%
  select(
    player_name,
    recent_team,
    receptions,
    targets,
    receiving_yards,
    receiving_yards_after_catch
  ) %>%
  filter(targets >= 100) %>% # Resolves cross-team abbreviation collisions
  mutate(
    air_yds = receiving_yards - receiving_yards_after_catch,
    air_ypr = air_yds / receptions,
    comp_pct = receptions / targets
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(receiving_yards))

# 3. Summarize the tracking data and merge with the 2024 leaderboard
t20_season_RTE_2024 <- all_plays %>% 
  group_by(player_name, nfl_id) %>% 
  summarize(
    mRTE = mean(peak_frame_efficiency),
    aRTE = mean(avg_play_efficiency),
    avg_final_eff = mean(final_frame_efficiency),
    routes_run = n(),
    .groups = "drop" # Cleanly drops grouping structure to prevent downstream warnings
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_final_eff)) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_abbr = case_when(
      player_name == "Amari Cooper" ~ "A.Cooper",
      player_name == "Brandon Aiyuk" ~ "B.Aiyuk",
      player_name == "Justin Jefferson" ~ "J.Jefferson",
      player_name == "George Pickens" ~ "G.Pickens",
      player_name == "Mike Evans" ~ "M.Evans",
      player_name == "DK Metcalf" ~ "D.Metcalf",
      player_name == "Tyreek Hill" ~ "T.Hill",
      player_name == "Devonta Smith" ~ "D.Smith",
      player_name == "Nico Collins" ~ "N.Collins",
      player_name == "AJ Brown" ~ "A.Brown",
      player_name == "Chris Olave" ~ "C.Olave",
      player_name == "DJ Moore" ~ "D.Moore",
      player_name == "Puka Nacua" ~ "P.Nacua",
      player_name == "CeeDee Lamb" ~ "C.Lamb",
      player_name == "Davantae Adams" ~ "D.Adams",
      player_name == "Keenan Allen" ~ "K.Allen",
      player_name == "Stefon Diggs" ~ "S.Diggs",
      player_name == "Amon-Ra St Brown" ~ "A.St. Brown",
      player_name == "Jamarr Chase" ~ "J.Chase",
      player_name == "Michael Pittman" ~ "M.Pittman",
      TRUE ~ player_name
    )
  ) %>% 
  # Execute the join on the pre-filtered 2024 target leaders
  left_join(receiving_leaderboard_2024, by = c("player_abbr" = "player_name")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(air_ypr)) %>% 
  mutate(target_rate = targets / routes_run)
```

Forward-looking gt table using RTE as a predictor for future success
```{r}
# 1. Prepare 2024 data scaled against 2023 reference values
gt_prep_2024 <- t20_season_RTE_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    # Min-max scaling anchored to 2023 population bounds
    mRTE_scaled          = (mRTE - mRTE_min) / (mRTE_max - mRTE_min) * 99,
    aRTE_scaled          = (aRTE - aRTE_min) / (aRTE_max - aRTE_min) * 99,
    avg_final_eff_scaled = (avg_final_eff - eff_min) / (eff_max - eff_min) * 99
  ) %>%
  select(
    player_name,
    recent_team,
    mRTE = mRTE_scaled,
    aRTE = aRTE_scaled,
    avg_final_eff = avg_final_eff_scaled,
    targets,
    air_yds,
    air_ypr,
    comp_pct,
    target_rate
  )

# 2. Construct the 2024 GT Table
gt_table_2024 <- gt_prep_2024 %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**2023 Wide Receiver RTE & 2024 Opportunity Metrics**"),
    subtitle = md("mRTE and aRTE relative scale (0–99 anchored to 2023) | 2023 Top 20 WRs, min 100 targets in 2024")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    player_name = "Player",
    recent_team = "Team",
    mRTE = "mRTE",
    aRTE = "aRTE",
    avg_final_eff = "fRTE",
    targets = "Targets",
    air_yds = "Air Yards",
    air_ypr = "Air YPR",
    comp_pct = "Catch %",
    target_rate = "Target Rate"
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = c(comp_pct, target_rate), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(mRTE, aRTE, avg_final_eff, air_ypr), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(targets, air_yds), decimals = 0) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = c(mRTE, aRTE, avg_final_eff),
    palette = c("#D73027", "#FFFFBF", "#1A9850")
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(player_name, recent_team)) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(mRTE, aRTE, avg_final_eff, targets, air_yds, air_ypr, comp_pct, target_rate)
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(13),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```

```{r}
rte_vars <- c("Long_mRTE", "Long_aRTE")

num_data <- t20_season_RTE_2023 %>%
  select(where(is.numeric), -nfl_id)   # drop the ID column

other_vars <- c("total_routes", "target_rate", "receiving_yards_after_catch","air_yds", "air_ypr")

# Rows = the 3 RTE metrics, columns = every other numeric stat
cor_mat <- cor(num_data[rte_vars], num_data[other_vars],
               use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

corr_matrix <- cor_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("rte_metric") %>%
  pivot_longer(-rte_metric, names_to = "stat", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(
    rte_metric = factor(rte_metric, levels = rev(rte_vars)),  # mRTE on top
    stat       = factor(stat, levels = other_vars)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(stat, rte_metric, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2)), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#D73027", mid = "#FFFFBF", high = "#1A9850",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(Medium_mRTE = "Long mRTE",
                              Medium_aRTE = "Long aRTE")) +  # match your gt table label
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    total_routes                  = "Routes Run",
    target_rate                 = "Target Rate",
    receiving_yards_after_catch = "Yards after Catch",
    air_yds                   = "Air Yards",
    air_ypr                     = "Air YPR"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Correlation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text        = element_text(face = "bold"),  # axis labels, legend title and key text
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("rte_corr.png", corr_matrix, width = 9, height = 3)
```

```{r}
MIN_ROUTES <- 15
# ---- Prep: flag targets/catches; credit air yards (route_depth) on catches only --
plays_prep <- all_plays %>%
  filter(player_name != "Trey Palmer") %>% 
  mutate(
    is_target = player_role == "Targeted Receiver",
    is_catch  = is_target & coalesce(pass_result == "C", FALSE),
    air_gain  = if_else(is_catch, route_depth, 0, missing = 0)
  )

# Each player's total targets across all route groups (for share_basis = "player")
player_tgt_totals <- plays_prep %>%
  group_by(nfl_id) %>%
  summarize(player_targets_all = sum(is_target), .groups = "drop")

# ---- Table builder -------------------------------------------------------------
# group:       "Short", "Medium", "Long", or "Ultra-Long"
# share_basis: "group"  = player's targets / all targets in this route group (Top-20 pool)
#              "player" = % of the player's own targets that came in this route group
make_top_mRTE_table <- function(group,
                                n           = 10,
                                min_routes  = MIN_ROUTES,
                                share_basis = c("group", "player"),
                                save        = TRUE) {
  share_basis <- match.arg(share_basis)

  grp_plays <- plays_prep %>% filter(route_group == group)
  if (nrow(grp_plays) == 0) stop("No plays found for route group: ", group)

  # Percentile functions: each receiver's median vs. all play-level values
  # in the same route group (same approach as the Top-20 table)
  ecdf_m <- ecdf(grp_plays$peak_frame_efficiency)
  ecdf_a <- ecdf(grp_plays$avg_play_efficiency)

  group_targets_total <- sum(grp_plays$is_target)

  tab <- grp_plays %>%
    group_by(player_name, nfl_id) %>%
    summarize(
      mRTE_raw = median(peak_frame_efficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
      aRTE_raw = median(avg_play_efficiency,   na.rm = TRUE),
      routes   = n(),
      targets  = sum(is_target),
      catches  = sum(is_catch),
      air_yds  = sum(air_gain),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(routes >= min_routes) %>%
    left_join(player_tgt_totals, by = "nfl_id") %>%
    mutate(
      mRTE = ecdf_m(mRTE_raw) * 100,
      aRTE = ecdf_a(aRTE_raw) * 100,
      tgt_share = if (share_basis == "group") {
        targets / group_targets_total
      } else {
        if_else(player_targets_all > 0, targets / player_targets_all, 0)
      },
      comp_pct     = if_else(targets > 0, catches / targets, NA_real_),
      yds_per_tgt  = if_else(targets > 0, air_yds / targets, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mRTE_raw)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n) %>%
    select(player_name, mRTE, aRTE, targets, tgt_share, comp_pct, yds_per_tgt)

  share_label <- if (share_basis == "group") "Target Share" else "% of Player's Targets"

  gt_tbl <- tab %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title    = md(paste0("**Top ", n, " mRTE: ", group, " Routes (2023)**")),
      subtitle = md(paste0(
        "mRTE / aRTE: Median route percentile vs. all Top-20 WR routes of the same depth | min ",
        min_routes, " routes"
      ))
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      player_name = "Player",
      mRTE        = "mRTE",
      aRTE        = "aRTE",
      targets     = "Targets",
      tgt_share   = share_label,
      comp_pct    = "Comp %",
      yds_per_tgt = "Air Rec Yds / Tgt"
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(mRTE, aRTE, yds_per_tgt), decimals = 1) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(targets), decimals = 0) %>%
    fmt_percent(columns = c(tgt_share, comp_pct), decimals = 1) %>%
    sub_missing(columns = c(comp_pct, yds_per_tgt), missing_text = "—") %>%
    data_color(
      columns  = c(mRTE, aRTE),
      palette  = c("#D73027", "#FFFFBF", "#1A9850"),
      domain   = c(0, 100),
      na_color = "#EEEEEE"
    ) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left",   columns = player_name) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(mRTE, aRTE, targets,
                                             tgt_share, comp_pct, yds_per_tgt)) %>%
    opt_row_striping() %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size           = px(13),
      heading.title.font.size   = px(16),
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
    )

  if (save) {
    gtsave(gt_tbl, filename = paste0("top", n, "_mRTE_", group, "_2023.png"))
  }
  gt_tbl
}

# ---- Run it --------------------------------------------------------------------
make_top_mRTE_table("Long", share_basis = "player")
make_top_mRTE_table("Short", share_basis = "player")
make_top_mRTE_table("Medium", share_basis = "player")
make_top_mRTE_table("Ultra-Long", share_basis = "player")
```
